_header: SYNTHETIC — invented for demonstration (2026-10-07). Not real manufacturer data.

documentation.title: Incompatible unit
documentation.description: The first edge touching the cement node gets a unit of a different dimension (mass → dimensionless).
documentation.expected: validateGraph raises DIM-002 → detectFaults reports unit_mismatch (trustworthy: false).

detected.detail: Edge "e-cement-cons" (consumes cement → batching): the flow "Cement — Type IL Portland (Supplier B: Blue Harbor Cement)" is mass; edge unit "%" has dimension dimensionless, expected mass.

documentation.title: Incorrect conversion
documentation.description: The admixture lb→kg converts_to edge quantity is corrupted (×10+1), so the audit edge disagrees with the unit table.
documentation.expected: validateGraph raises CNV-001 → detectFaults reports bad_conversion (trustworthy: false).

detected.detail: Edge "e-admixture-conv": bad conversion — "Admixture — polycarboxylate superplasticizer" is 4.8502 lb (= 2.200013712974 kg in base units) but the edge claims 23.00013712974 kg (= 23.00013712974 kg).

documentation.title: Missing input source
documentation.description: The admixture node's quantity is deleted — its input data vanishes while the factor remains.
documentation.expected: validateGraph raises QTY-001 → detectFaults reports missing_input (trustworthy: false).

detected.detail: Node "Admixture — polycarboxylate superplasticizer" (admixture, kind material_input) has no quantity — its input is missing.

documentation.title: Duplicated contribution
documentation.description: The first applies_factor edge (admixture) is wired a second time — its contribution is double-counted.
documentation.expected: detectFaults reports duplicate_contribution (trustworthy: false); GWP rises by one admixture contribution.

detected.detail: Duplicate contribution: "EF — Admixture — polycarboxylate superplasticizer" is wired into "GWP" twice (edges "e-admixture-app", "e-admixture-app__dup") — its contribution is double-counted.

documentation.title: Expired data reference
documentation.description: The cement factor node's dataset version is suffixed '-bogus', making it unresolvable (treated as expired).

detected.detail: Node "EF — Cement — Type IL Portland (Supplier B: Blue Harbor Cement)" (f_cement) references unknown dataset "cement-lca@v2024.1-bogus" — the factor cannot be verified and is treated as expired.

documentation.title: Dependency cycle
documentation.description: A converts_to back-edge is added from the batching process to the admixture flow — a physical impossibility.
documentation.expected: validateGraph raises CYC-001 → detectFaults reports cycle (trustworthy: false); evaluation refuses.

detected.detail: Dependency cycle detected: batching → admixture → batching. Evaluation cannot terminate; no result is computable.

documentation.title: Suspicious silent change
documentation.description: The cement factor is scaled ×100 with no dataset change — trips the dominance heuristic.
documentation.expected: detectFaults reports suspicious_value (trustworthy: true — flagged with a warning, still presentable).

detected.detail: Suspicious value: "EF — Cement — Type IL Portland (Supplier B: Blue Harbor Cement)" contributes 11788.00 kgCO2e, more than 10× the median contribution (3.78 kgCO2e). Flagged for human review (heuristic threshold, not proof of error).
